subject: Post-discovery coordination: lock a 30-min intro and stakeholder windows for VectorHealth
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maria Ortiz <maria.ortiz@vectorhealth.com>, Allen Wu <allen.wu@vectorhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 04 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick post-call recap + next step (30‑min intro)

Thanks again for taking the time today—great conversation. Quick recap from our discovery: your primary goals are lowering inference cost for low-latency endpoints, standardizing model rollout across environments, and improving observability tied to cost per request.

Next step: we'd love to run a 30‑minute product intro (high-level + time for stakeholder Qs) with engineering and the ML ops lead. Could you share 2–3 windows that work for the core stakeholders next week? To make it easy I included a short one‑pager and a proposed prep agenda in the attachments.

Suggested availability (we can match your timezone):
- Tue 9–11am PT
- Wed 2–4pm PT
- Thu 1–3pm PT

If it helps, here's a booking link where you can pick a slot directly: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min-vectorhealth

Attachments: prod-one-pager.pdf

Onwards—once we lock a time we'll include a brief agenda and who from our side will attend (engineering + solutions). Thanks,

—Stephanie Nguyen
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555‑0192
From: Maria Ortiz <maria.ortiz@vectorhealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 04 Mar 2027 18:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Quick post-call recap + next step (30‑min intro)

Thanks, Stephanie — good summary.

Attendees from our side: myself (Maria Ortiz, Head of Product), Allen Wu (SRE Manager), Noah Brooks (Director, ML Ops). We prefer afternoons PT next week (we're on ET but can meet earlier in our day). Can you do:
- Tue 2027-03-09 between 2:00–4:00pm PT
- Wed 2027-03-10 after 3:00pm PT

Also, please include a technical SME who can speak to quantization/latency tradeoffs and a short checklist of prep items for Noah.

I'll hold time tentatively for Tue 3pm PT if that helps while we confirm.

Best,
Maria
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maria Ortiz <maria.ortiz@vectorhealth.com>, Allen Wu <allen.wu@vectorhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Mar 2027 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick post-call recap + next step (30‑min intro)

Appreciate the fast reply, Maria — Tue 3pm PT works well for our team. I'll send a calendar invite for 2027-03-09 15:00–15:30 PT and include Marissa (Solutions Engineer) and our lead infra engineer, David Kim, to cover quantization/latency tradeoffs.

Prep checklist for Noah (short):
- Access pattern summary (peak qps, typical seq len)
- Current model + deployment config (region, GPU type, replicas)
- Any latency SLOs and current p50/p95

I've attached a 1‑page agenda so stakeholders know the flow.

Attachments: prep-agenda.pdf
Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123vector
HubSpot: https://hubspot.com/contacts/VEC-4821

Thanks — invite incoming.

—Stephanie
From: Allen Wu <allen.wu@vectorhealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Maria Ortiz <maria.ortiz@vectorhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Mar 2027 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick post-call recap + next step (30‑min intro)

Confirmed — Tue 2027-03-09 3:00pm PT works. I've forwarded the tentative hold to Noah and our infra calendar.

See you then.

—Allen
